— Confusables and KG hints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, How to Apply for Your Oklahoma Driver License

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Newcomers holding other-state licenses must earn an Oklahoma card and plate their vehicles once resident, while military personnel with spouses may stay exempt [A01].
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Out-of-state students ride on valid home-state licenses, while farm tractor and implement hands need no license at all for pure field work [A01].
Why it matters: group exemptions; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Counters take original or certified identity papers only, so notarized copies and photocopies always fail [A01].
Why it matters: group identity-docs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A02
Log name changes with Social Security before seeking the card update, and never expect titles or church names to print [A02].
Why it matters: group name-change; difficulty low; prereq sec01-F03; confusables sec01-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
An application receipt never proves lawful presence, and visitors plus residency-ineligible immigrants draw no license [A02].
Why it matters: group legal-presence; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
Starting May seventh twenty twenty-five, only REAL ID cards or federal IDs board domestic flights and enter military bases, named federal buildings, and nuclear plants [A02].
Why it matters: group real-id; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A03
Eighteen opens both commercial and Class D, but commercial rigs need manual study plus registry training while Class D needs no course at all [A03].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A03
Commercial permits wait fourteen days for skills while Class D permits wait thirty, both cap tries at three before monthly retakes, yet the written-to-road path tests next business day and then demands a thirty-day permit after three failures [A03].
Why it matters: group test-timing; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F08; confusables sec01-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A03
Sixteen with schooling beats sixteen-and-one-half without for intermediate timing, six-month restriction clearance beats a full year with schooling, and fifteen needs course papers where sixteen needs none for a learner permit [A03].
Why it matters: group teen-timing; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F09; confusables sec01-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A04
Endorsements attach to a live license with course waivers possible, while motorcycle-only at fourteen starts from vision, written, skills, and the bike manual [A04].
Why it matters: group motorcycle-paths; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A04
Small-bike riders keep a half-past-four-to-nine solo window with mid-size posted-limit carve-outs until sixteen, plus a certified rider course under eighteen [A04].
Why it matters: group motorcycle-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A04
Permits need watchful endorsed supervision, a number-nine restriction at sixteen or fifteen with schooling, thirty days to clear, and a liability-accepting parent signature at fourteen and fifteen, while ID cards need only residency, proof, a visit, and under-eighteen consent [A04].
Why it matters: group permits-and-id; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F11; confusables sec01-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A05
Parent-taught courses charge vendor fees, pace to the student without shortcutting, and still require thirty classroom plus fifty-five driving hours [A05].
Why it matters: group driver-ed; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F13 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A05
Teens drive five in the morning through ten at night except for work, school, worship, or a twenty-one-plus companion, carry at most one outsider passenger under the same exception, and freeze at-level six months past a moving conviction [A05].
Why it matters: group gdl; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F13; confusables sec01-F14 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A06
All three Class D exams test free, money changes hands only after passing, and a paper temporary bridges to the mailed plastic [A06].
Why it matters: group exam-admin; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F15 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A06
Written questions lift from this manual, oral sittings come on request, and failure idles retakes a full day [A06].
Why it matters: group written-test; difficulty low; prereq sec01-F15; confusables sec01-F16 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A06
Certified instructors sell skills sittings while Service Oklahoma gives them free, and slick or hazardous pavement cancels every road test [A06].
Why it matters: group road-test; difficulty low; prereq sec01-F15; confusables sec01-F17 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A07
Learners and young riders gate driving on age plus permit tenure, renewals split at three lapsed years between nothing and everything, and valid out-of-state transfers keep vision while shedding the rest at examiner discretion [A07].
Why it matters: group table-two; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F15; confusables sec01-F18 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A07
Error counts, danger, violations, crashes, and refusals fail road tests with faults explained and dates set, while donor yes binds as a red-heart consent and no simply opts out with family notice optional [A07].
Why it matters: group fails-and-donor; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F19 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A08
Veteran logos cost nothing but demand service proof while card fees still apply, and relocating offenders face ten days for Corrections but three for local police [A08].
Why it matters: group logo-and-offenders; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F20 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A08
Carry and display duties pair with primary-ID proof for every card transaction, and the June table prices Class D at forty-two fifty while sixty-five-plus pays nothing [A08].
Why it matters: group duties-and-fees; difficulty low; prereq sec01-F04; confusables sec01-F21 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A09
Chapter-twelve equipment faces section inspection, and the pre-test list checks plate, lamps with third-light years, glass and tint bounds, tire tread and shape, horn reach, brakes, handles, belts, mirrors, and driver-covering insurance [A09].
Why it matters: group inspection; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F22 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0012]
